shops.shape: 3-7-7 digits, or D01-… for digital orders.
GSH and 12 letters or digits: GSH000000000000.
The order's date (YYMMDD) and 8 letters and digits: 261025ABCD1234. One of the 8 is a letter, so a carrier's 14 digits that start like a date stay a tracking number.
PO, 3 digits and 17: PO-000-00000000000000000, often typed without the hyphens.

examples.why: A real number beside the order number wins.

examples.text: Your Shein order GSH0A1B2C3D4E5F has shipped

examples.why: A character too many or too few is no Shein order number.

examples.text: Shopee order 261025ABCD1234 is on its way

examples.why: 14 digits that start like a date are a carrier's, as is a date no calendar has.
A character too many or too few is no Shopee order number.

examples.text:
Order PO-000-12345678901234567
Thanks for shopping with us

examples.why: A digit too many or too few, or no PO, is no Temu order number.
A carrier's number that starts with PO stays a tracking number: here Australia Post's, a digit short of Temu's.
